# MSB-17 parts table (generated by blender/msb1780/export_msb1780.py from the B-17G exporter)

Unity coordinates: x right, y up, z forward (nose). Pivot = object origin in model space relative to MSB17_root = the CG, which is the FBX origin (gear down). Unity collapses the single FBX root node into the prefab root, so the prefab root IS MSB17_root. Rotation rule: a Blender rotation of +a deg about axis (x, y, z) is Unity `Quaternion.AngleAxis(-a, new Vector3(x, z, y))`.
